turns.query: For each air quality monitoring station, compute the distance to its nearest fellow air quality monitoring station. Return the top 3 most isolated stations (largest nearest-neighbor distance) with their names and distances in meters.

code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

query = text("""
WITH nearest AS (
  SELECT
    a.id,
    a.name_en,
    MIN(ST_Distance(a.coordinate, b.coordinate))::double precision AS nearest_distance_m
  FROM air_quality_station a
  JOIN air_quality_station b ON a.id <> b.id
  GROUP BY a.id, a.name_en
)
SELECT name_en, nearest_distance_m
FROM nearest
ORDER BY nearest_distance_m DESC
LIMIT 3
""")
